authority: Packaged index of frozen method-selection evidence; not an image classifier, physical qualification or provider receipt

research_scope.independence: Design pairs/states reuse some base expected images; not independent specimens

methods.use_when: Existing selected-support frequency/geometry observations answer the question; directional context can test corroboration or mixture
limits: Each core/arm retains its own support
Arm-only frequency is not core evidence
Peak presence is not physical periodicity, phase identity or defect absence

methods.use_when: Discuss the frozen bounded variable-projection prototype as research history; a new comparison needs separate scope
limits: No production dispatch in this integration
Isolated high-count gains do not imply low-count or near-frequency gains
Linear rank and optimizer convergence do not establish nonlinear identifiability or physical resolution

methods.use_when: Report raw target/reference measurements, signed contrast, profile observations or reference disagreement on fixed sites
limits: No occupancy or defect classification follows from availability

methods.use_when: Discuss the frozen isolated-column fit as research history rather than a default replacement
limits: No production dispatch in this integration
Neighbour/background mixing and shape mismatch remain relevant

methods.use_when: A central-component versus neighbour/background question warrants a separate conditional decomposition alongside S0
methods.missing_premise_route: Retain scoped UNKNOWN or request revision. Optional count/geometry/width prerequisites may be missing/unsupported in a legal raw + UNKNOWN request; required MCP reference fields still apply. Reference equivalence is not an automatic worker gate.
counterexamples: S02 zero target: S2 is not uniformly better
S09 non-Gaussian target: conditional component bias remains
S10 supplied width mismatch: target-site eligibility cannot replace complete-row eligibility
limits: Fixed Gaussian shape/width/geometry and count interpretation remain unverified premises
Central integral is extrapolated to the whole plane, not the observed ROI sum
Every requested reference must qualify for fitted contrast
Rank/convergence is not statistical or physical identifiability

historical_boundaries.meaning: Historical records retained; this routing integration does not update physical conclusions
